## Summary

- describe the change
- note any user-facing or operator-facing impact

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] relevant live browser command, if applicable

## Safety Checks

- [ ] no deletion behavior changed, or deletion changes are explicitly called out
- [ ] checkpointing/logging behavior remains intact
- [ ] docs/ADRs updated if architecture or operator workflow changed
